title: calostephane madagascariensis
intro: Calostephane madagascariensis, commonly known as the Madagascan or Madagascar calostephane, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Calostephane madagascariensis include its potential to act as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
